title: Ayush Shetty Stuns World No. 1 Shi Yuqi in World Championships Opener

summary: Ayush Shetty created a sensation at the BWF World Championships by knocking out top seed and defending champion Shi Yuqi of China in a thrilling three-game encounter, delighting the home crowd.
